item.description: The last time the United States made a bold purchase of territory, it was "Seward's Folly" of Alaska. That worked out pretty well.

item.title: Hawaii Wants to Say 'Aloha' to Second Amendment Rights
item.description: Several Supreme Court justices appeared skeptical that Hawaii's restrictions, which pit private property rights against gun rights, meet constitutional muster.

item.title: 'Thank You for Your Attention' to Trump's First Year
item.description: In the first year of his second term, the president has set a dizzying pace of action that aims to upend the status quo at home and abroad.

item.title: Conservatives Must Always Stand for Truth
item.description: We must uniformly and unequivocally denounce the woke influencers on the far Right who undermine our devotion to Liberty and conservative values and policies.
